title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 6

blocks.source_text: It's getting chilly in here! This week's 26.4 Snapshot 6 brings snow bricks, a new set of building blocks for anyone who wants their builds to look even cooler ;) We're also adding a new archetype to the Sulfur Cube family: the Cold Sulfur Cube. It's a frosty little friend that knows a thing or two about ice.
blocks.translated_text: 这里变得冷飕飕的了！本周的 26.4 版本更新（Snapshot 6）带来了雪砖，这是一组新的建筑材料，能让你的建筑看起来更加酷炫 ;) 我们还为硫方怪（Sulfur Cube）系列添加了一个新的原型：冷硫方怪（Cold Sulfur Cube）。它是个喜欢在冰上活动的家伙，对冰有很多了解。

blocks.source_text: Stay cool and happy building!
blocks.translated_text: 建造时保持冷静和愉快吧！

blocks.source_text: New Features
blocks.translated_text: 新功能

blocks.source_text: Added Snow Bricks
blocks.translated_text: 增加了雪砖

blocks.source_text: Added new Cold Sulfur Cube archetype
blocks.translated_text: 新增了冷硫方怪原型

blocks.source_text: Snow Bricks
blocks.translated_text: 雪砖

blocks.source_text: Snow Bricks can be crafted from 2x2 Snow Blocks
blocks.translated_text: 雪砖可以用 2x2 的雪块（Snow Blocks）制作

blocks.source_text: Snow Bricks have a Slab, Stair, and Wall variant
blocks.translated_text: 雪砖有平板、楼梯和墙壁三种类型

blocks.source_text: A Stonecutter cannot be used to craft Snow Brick Slabs, Stairs, and Walls
blocks.translated_text: 切石机（Stonecutter）无法用于制作雪砖平板、楼梯和墙壁

blocks.source_text: Snow Bricks belong to the Fast Sliding Sulfur Cube archetype
blocks.translated_text: 雪砖属于“快速滑动的硫方怪”（Fast Sliding Sulfur Cube）原型

blocks.source_text: Snow Bricks only drop themselves if mined with a Shovel
blocks.translated_text: 只有使用铲子挖掘时，雪砖才会掉落

blocks.source_text: Cold Sulfur Cube Archetype
blocks.translated_text: “冷硫方怪”原型

blocks.source_text: A new Sulfur Cube archetype that belongs to the special archetype category
blocks.translated_text: 一种属于特殊原型类别的新硫方怪原型

blocks.source_text: It has the same properties as the Fast Sliding archetype, but floats and replaces water below it with a disk of Frosted Ice when it moves, similar to the Frost Walker enchantment
blocks.translated_text: 它具有与“快速滑动”原型相同的属性，但在移动时会漂浮，并将下方的水替换为霜冻冰块，类似于“霜冻行者”附魔

blocks.source_text: Air blocks above the water block are required for Frosted Ice placement
blocks.translated_text: 放置霜冻冰块需要水方块上方的空气方块

blocks.source_text: Will only place Frosted Ice if the Sulfur Cube starts its movement while it is on ground
blocks.translated_text: 只有当硫方怪在地面时开始移动时，才会放置霜冻冰块

blocks.source_text: Used when the Sulfur Cube absorbs a Blue Ice block
blocks.translated_text: 当硫方怪吸收蓝色冰块时使用的状态

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 发生了变更

blocks.source_text: Changed the default JVM options
blocks.translated_text: 更改了默认的JVM选项

blocks.source_text: Mobs falling through lava may take slightly less fall damage in some cases
blocks.translated_text: 在某些情况下，从熔岩中掉落的怪物受到的坠落伤害可能会稍低

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对方块、物品和实体进行了一些小调整

blocks.source_text: All Packed Ice Brick variants will now require a pickaxe to be mined in order to drop themselves
blocks.translated_text: 现在所有压缩冰砖（Packed Ice Brick）在开采时都需要使用镐才能掉落

blocks.source_text: Brittle Ice will no longer crack when a Stray is standing on top of it
blocks.translated_text: 脆冰（Brittle Ice）上站立的流浪生物（Stray）不会再导致冰块破裂

blocks.source_text: Sounds
blocks.translated_text: 声音相关改动

blocks.source_text: Added ambient sounds to Ice Crystals
blocks.translated_text: 为冰晶（Ice Crystals）添加了环境音效

blocks.source_text: An Ice crystal block has a chance of playing an ambient sound if it has a block of packed ice below
blocks.translated_text: 如果冰晶块下方有压缩冰砖，该冰晶块有可能播放环境音效

blocks.source_text: Default JVM Options
blocks.translated_text: 默认的JVM选项

blocks.source_text: The game now automatically sets its Java heap size based on your system's RAM, using up to 25% with a maximum of 4 GB
blocks.translated_text: 游戏现在会根据你的系统内存自动设置Java堆内存大小，最多使用25%，最大值为4GB

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术性改动

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 125.1
blocks.translated_text: 数据包（Data Pack）的版本现在是125.1

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 101.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本现已更新至101.0

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 125.1
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本更新至125.1

blocks.source_text: Sulfur Cube Archetypes
blocks.translated_text: 新增“硫方怪”（Sulfur Cube）原型

blocks.source_text: Added new location_based_effects field - an optional list of location-based effects
blocks.translated_text: 新增了`location_based_effects`字段——这是一个可选的基于位置效果的列表

blocks.source_text: The format for each entry is exactly the same as a location-based enchantment effect
blocks.translated_text: 每个条目的格式与基于位置的附魔效果完全相同

blocks.source_text: Level-based values in this definition will always be evaluated with level 1
blocks.translated_text: 此定义中的等级相关值始终以等级1进行评估

blocks.source_text: World Generation
blocks.translated_text: 世界生成（World Generation）相关更新

blocks.source_text: Density Functions
blocks.translated_text: 密度函数（Density Functions）相关更新

blocks.source_text: Changed
blocks.translated_text: 部分内容已更改

blocks.source_text: gradient
blocks.translated_text: 新增“gradient”（渐变效果）

blocks.source_text: The from_coordinate and to_coordinate fields now additionally accept a Vertical Anchor, as long as axis is y
blocks.translated_text: `from.coordinate` 和 `to.coordinate` 字段现在还支持一个垂直锚点（Vertical Anchor），前提是轴是 y 轴。

blocks.source_text: Added
blocks.translated_text: 已添加

blocks.source_text: domain_warp
blocks.translated_text: `domain_warp`

blocks.source_text: Samples an input function by applying an offset to each sampled coordinate.
blocks.translated_text: 通过为每个采样坐标应用偏移量来测试输入函数。

blocks.source_text: Note: if the offsets change rapidly by large amount, performance may degrade significantly. This function should be used sparingly.
blocks.translated_text: 注意：如果偏移量发生剧烈且快速的变化，性能可能会显著下降。应谨慎使用此函数。

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：带有字段的对象。

blocks.source_text: input - Density Function, the input function to sample
blocks.translated_text: `input` - 密度函数（Density Function），用于采样的输入函数。

blocks.source_text: offset_x - Density Function, the offset to apply to sampled X coordinates
blocks.translated_text: `offset_x` - 密度函数（Density Function），应用于采样 X 坐标的偏移量。

blocks.source_text: The result is implicitly truncated to an integer
blocks.translated_text: 结果会自动被截断为整数。

blocks.source_text: If not specified, defaults to: 0.0
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，默认值为：0.0

blocks.source_text: offset_y - Density Function, the offset to apply to sampled Y coordinates
blocks.translated_text: 偏移量_y - 密度函数，用于对采样的 Y 坐标应用的偏移量

blocks.source_text: The result is implicitly truncated to an integer
blocks.translated_text: 结果会隐式地被截断为整数

blocks.source_text: If not specified, defaults to: 0.0
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，默认值为：0.0

blocks.source_text: offset_z - Density Function, the offset to apply to sampled Z coordinates
blocks.translated_text: 偏移量_z - 密度函数，用于对采样的 Z 坐标应用的偏移量

blocks.source_text: The result is implicitly truncated to an integer
blocks.translated_text: 结果会隐式地被截断为整数

blocks.source_text: If not specified, defaults to: 0.0
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，默认值为：0.0

blocks.source_text: At least one of offset_x, offset_y, or offset_z must be specified.
blocks.translated_text: 必须至少指定 offset_x、offset_y 或 offset_z 中的一个

blocks.source_text: Structure Pool Elements
blocks.translated_text: 结构池元素

blocks.source_text: Added optional
blocks.translated_text: 已添加可选选项

blocks.source_text: corner_constraint
blocks.translated_text: 角点约束

blocks.source_text: Field
blocks.translated_text: 字段

blocks.source_text: Limits the placement of a structure pool element this by sampling a Density Function at the corners of its bounding box.
blocks.translated_text: 通过在结构池元素的边界框的角点处采样密度函数来限制其放置位置

blocks.source_text: Format: list of objects with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含字段的对象列表

blocks.source_text: density_function - the Density Function to sample at the bounding box' corner
blocks.translated_text: density_function - 在边界框的角点处采样的密度函数

blocks.source_text: acceptable_density - inclusive range of doubles, a corner's sampled density within this range counts as "inside"
blocks.translated_text: acceptable_density - 双精度浮点数的可接受范围；在指定范围内的采样密度被视为‘内部’

blocks.source_text: padding - integer between 0 and 8 , the padding of the bounding box before sampling its corners
blocks.translated_text: padding - 0到8之间的整数；在采样边界框的角点之前的填充量

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to 0
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，则默认为0

blocks.source_text: corners - one of all , top , or bottom , which corners to check
blocks.translated_text: corners - 可以检查的角点：top（顶部）、bottom（底部）或all（全部）

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to all
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，则默认为全部角点

blocks.source_text: required_corners - range between 1 and 8 , the number of corners that must be inside acceptable_density for the check to pass
blocks.translated_text: required_corners - 1到8之间的范围；必须有多个角点在指定的可接受密度范围内，检查才能通过

blocks.source_text: [MC-269319](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-269319) - Bringing the camera close to the player in third-person view underwater disables the water overlay and zoom effect
blocks.translated_text: [MC-269319] - 在水下第三人称视角下将摄像机拉近玩家时，水面的叠加效果和缩放效果会失效

blocks.source_text: [MC-308361](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308361) - Small sulfur cubes that split from bucketed sulfur cubes can despawn

blocks.source_text: [MC-311992](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311992) - The code used to join a Realm is inconsistently referred to as both an "Invite Code" and a "Join Code"

content:
It's getting chilly in here! This week's 26.4 Snapshot 6 brings snow bricks, a new set of building blocks for anyone who wants their builds to look even cooler ;) We're also adding a new archetype to the Sulfur Cube family: the Cold Sulfur Cube. It's a frosty little friend that knows a thing or two about ice.

Stay cool and happy building!

New Features

Added Snow Bricks

Added new Cold Sulfur Cube archetype

Snow Bricks

Snow Bricks can be crafted from 2x2 Snow Blocks

Snow Bricks have a Slab, Stair, and Wall variant

A Stonecutter cannot be used to craft Snow Brick Slabs, Stairs, and Walls

Snow Bricks belong to the Fast Sliding Sulfur Cube archetype

Snow Bricks only drop themselves if mined with a Shovel

Cold Sulfur Cube Archetype

A new Sulfur Cube archetype that belongs to the special archetype category

It has the same properties as the Fast Sliding archetype, but floats and replaces water below it with a disk of Frosted Ice when it moves, similar to the Frost Walker enchantment

Air blocks above the water block are required for Frosted Ice placement

Will only place Frosted Ice if the Sulfur Cube starts its movement while it is on ground

Used when the Sulfur Cube absorbs a Blue Ice block

Changes

Changed the default JVM options

Mobs falling through lava may take slightly less fall damage in some cases

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

All Packed Ice Brick variants will now require a pickaxe to be mined in order to drop themselves

Brittle Ice will no longer crack when a Stray is standing on top of it

Sounds

Added ambient sounds to Ice Crystals

An Ice crystal block has a chance of playing an ambient sound if it has a block of packed ice below

Default JVM Options

The game now automatically sets its Java heap size based on your system's RAM, using up to 25% with a maximum of 4 GB

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 125.1

The Resource Pack version is now 101.0

Data Pack Version 125.1

Sulfur Cube Archetypes

Added new location_based_effects field - an optional list of location-based effects

The format for each entry is exactly the same as a location-based enchantment effect

Level-based values in this definition will always be evaluated with level 1

World Generation

Density Functions

Changed

gradient

The from_coordinate and to_coordinate fields now additionally accept a Vertical Anchor, as long as axis is y

Added

domain_warp

Samples an input function by applying an offset to each sampled coordinate.

Note: if the offsets change rapidly by large amount, performance may degrade significantly. This function should be used sparingly.

Format: object with fields:

input - Density Function, the input function to sample

offset_x - Density Function, the offset to apply to sampled X coordinates

The result is implicitly truncated to an integer

If not specified, defaults to: 0.0

offset_y - Density Function, the offset to apply to sampled Y coordinates

The result is implicitly truncated to an integer

If not specified, defaults to: 0.0

offset_z - Density Function, the offset to apply to sampled Z coordinates

The result is implicitly truncated to an integer

If not specified, defaults to: 0.0

At least one of offset_x, offset_y, or offset_z must be specified.

Structure Pool Elements

Added optional

corner_constraint

Field

Limits the placement of a structure pool element this by sampling a Density Function at the corners of its bounding box.

Format: list of objects with fields:

density_function - the Density Function to sample at the bounding box' corner

acceptable_density - inclusive range of doubles, a corner's sampled density within this range counts as "inside"

padding - integer between 0 and 8 , the padding of the bounding box before sampling its corners

If not present, defaults to 0

corners - one of all , top , or bottom , which corners to check

If not present, defaults to all

required_corners - range between 1 and 8 , the number of corners that must be inside acceptable_density for the check to pass

Tags

Fluid Tags

Added #swimmable for fluids that players can swim in

Item Tags

Added #sulfur_cube_archetype/cold - items that can be placed inside the Sulfur Cube that turns it into a Cold Sulfur Cube archetype

Entity Type Tags

Added #swimming - entity types that are considered swimming in water

Added #flying - entity types that are considered flying

Resource Pack Version 101.0

Block Sprites

Added new Block textures:

block/snow_bricks.png

Sounds

Added new sound events:

block.ice_crystal.ambient

Block Models

Removed Block Models:

block/cube_top

Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 6

[MC-312632](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312632) - Icicles and sulfur spikes are not part of the #dangerous_for_teleportation block tag, unlike pointed dripstone

[MC-312638](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312638) - Music discs ejected from jukeboxes with chests above them spawn inside the chests

[MC-312639](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312639) - Opening a screen while in a world automatically focuses a button if the tab or any of the arrow keys was used previously

[MC-312651](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312651) - The bottom face of a jukebox uses its new texture when the "Programmer Art" resource pack is enabled

[MC-312665](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312665) - The game crashes in the pause menu when the music toast is on and a music track cannot be played

[MC-312678](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312678) - Spruce wall hanging signs use the oak map color on maps

[MC-312682](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312682) - Lava can start fires next to crimson and warped shelves

[MC-312775](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312775) - UI elements from screens behind popups can be hovered over with the mouse cursor

[MC-312778](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312778) - Red and brown mushrooms can visually float on top of walls that have the up block state property set to false

[MC-312780](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312780) - Oak, birch, spruce, and jungle trees no longer convert the block below their trunks into dirt

[MC-312783](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312783) - Consumable and equippable items lose their default sounds after upgrading worlds

[MC-312801](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312801) - Magma cubes stop being visible at a shorter distance than slimes and sulfur cubes of the same size

[MC-312804](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312804) - Some villager trades still unexpectedly differ from 1.21.11

Get the Snapshot

Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Snapshot, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.

translated_content:
这里变得冷飕飕的了！本周的 26.4 版本更新（Snapshot 6）带来了雪砖，这是一组新的建筑材料，能让你的建筑看起来更加酷炫 ;) 我们还为硫方怪（Sulfur Cube）系列添加了一个新的原型：冷硫方怪（Cold Sulfur Cube）。它是个喜欢在冰上活动的家伙，对冰有很多了解。

建造时保持冷静和愉快吧！

新功能

增加了雪砖

新增了冷硫方怪原型

雪砖

雪砖可以用 2x2 的雪块（Snow Blocks）制作

雪砖有平板、楼梯和墙壁三种类型

切石机（Stonecutter）无法用于制作雪砖平板、楼梯和墙壁

雪砖属于“快速滑动的硫方怪”（Fast Sliding Sulfur Cube）原型

只有使用铲子挖掘时，雪砖才会掉落

“冷硫方怪”原型

一种属于特殊原型类别的新硫方怪原型

它具有与“快速滑动”原型相同的属性，但在移动时会漂浮，并将下方的水替换为霜冻冰块，类似于“霜冻行者”附魔

放置霜冻冰块需要水方块上方的空气方块

只有当硫方怪在地面时开始移动时，才会放置霜冻冰块

当硫方怪吸收蓝色冰块时使用的状态

发生了变更

更改了默认的JVM选项

在某些情况下，从熔岩中掉落的怪物受到的坠落伤害可能会稍低

对方块、物品和实体进行了一些小调整

现在所有压缩冰砖（Packed Ice Brick）在开采时都需要使用镐才能掉落

脆冰（Brittle Ice）上站立的流浪生物（Stray）不会再导致冰块破裂

声音相关改动

为冰晶（Ice Crystals）添加了环境音效

如果冰晶块下方有压缩冰砖，该冰晶块有可能播放环境音效

默认的JVM选项

游戏现在会根据你的系统内存自动设置Java堆内存大小，最多使用25%，最大值为4GB

技术性改动

数据包（Data Pack）的版本现在是125.1

资源包版本现已更新至101.0

数据包版本更新至125.1

新增“硫方怪”（Sulfur Cube）原型

新增了`location_based_effects`字段——这是一个可选的基于位置效果的列表

每个条目的格式与基于位置的附魔效果完全相同

此定义中的等级相关值始终以等级1进行评估

世界生成（World Generation）相关更新

密度函数（Density Functions）相关更新

部分内容已更改

新增“gradient”（渐变效果）

`from.coordinate` 和 `to.coordinate` 字段现在还支持一个垂直锚点（Vertical Anchor），前提是轴是 y 轴。

已添加

`domain_warp`

通过为每个采样坐标应用偏移量来测试输入函数。

注意：如果偏移量发生剧烈且快速的变化，性能可能会显著下降。应谨慎使用此函数。

格式：带有字段的对象。

`input` - 密度函数（Density Function），用于采样的输入函数。

`offset_x` - 密度函数（Density Function），应用于采样 X 坐标的偏移量。

结果会自动被截断为整数。

如果未指定，默认值为：0.0

偏移量_y - 密度函数，用于对采样的 Y 坐标应用的偏移量

结果会隐式地被截断为整数

如果未指定，默认值为：0.0

偏移量_z - 密度函数，用于对采样的 Z 坐标应用的偏移量

结果会隐式地被截断为整数

如果未指定，默认值为：0.0

必须至少指定 offset_x、offset_y 或 offset_z 中的一个

结构池元素

已添加可选选项

角点约束

字段

通过在结构池元素的边界框的角点处采样密度函数来限制其放置位置

格式：包含字段的对象列表

density_function - 在边界框的角点处采样的密度函数

acceptable_density - 双精度浮点数的可接受范围；在指定范围内的采样密度被视为‘内部’

padding - 0到8之间的整数；在采样边界框的角点之前的填充量

如果未指定，则默认为0

corners - 可以检查的角点：top（顶部）、bottom（底部）或all（全部）

如果未指定，则默认为全部角点

required_corners - 1到8之间的范围；必须有多个角点在指定的可接受密度范围内，检查才能通过

标签

流体标签

为可让玩家游泳的流体添加了 #swimmable 标签

物品标签

添加了 #sulfur_cube_archetype/cold 标签——这些物品可以放置在硫方怪内，使其变成冷硫方怪

实体类型标签

为在水中的实体类型添加了 #swimming 标签

为在空中移动的实体类型添加了 #flying 标签

资源包版本 101.0

区块精灵

添加了新的块纹理：</text

block/snow_bricks.png

音效

添加了新的音效事件：</text

block.ice_crystal.ambient

块模型

移除了块模型：</text

block/cube_top

修复了26.4版本Snapshot 6中的错误

[MC-127491](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-127491) - 淹死的村民和变成僵尸的猪灵会拥有DrownedConversionTime和InWaterTime标签

[MC-269319] - 在水下第三人称视角下将摄像机拉近玩家时，水面的叠加效果和缩放效果会失效

[MC-308361] - 从装满硫磺的桶中分离出来的小硫磺方块会消失

[MC-311992] - 用于加入服务器的代码被不一致地称为“邀请码”（Invite Code）和“加入码”（Join Code）

[MC-311994] - 延迟破坏方块的逻辑有时会过早完成，有时会卡住

[MC-312016] - 当玩家头部碰到上方的方块时，水面叠加效果无法显示

[MC-312270] - 在观察怪物时尝试打开背包会导致游戏崩溃

[MC-312384](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312384) - 当玩家处于冻结状态（Freezing）时站在火或熔岩中，会频繁触发灭火声音

[MC-312450](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312450) - 在破坏方块之前立即跳跃会导致方块短暂重新出现

[MC-312489] - “How Did We Get Here?”（我们的起点）这一成就并不需要冻结效果

[MC-312490] - “A Furious Cocktail”（暴怒鸡尾酒）这一成就也不需要冻结效果

[MC-312501](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312501) - 多人游戏中的 `other_players.not_available` 这个字符串缺少动词，并且大小写使用不正确

[MC-312529] - 在 `gui.player_options.unfriend.confirm` 中，提到的好友列表被表述为“your Friends”，这与其他类似字符串的用法不一致
